sections.head: Test the Salesforce org around the agent

items.a: Agentforce testing checks that Salesforce Agentforce agents choose the right topics and actions, use correct arguments, stay grounded in org data and respect guardrails.

items.q: How is this different from Agentforce Testing Center?
items.a: Salesforce's Agentforce Testing Center tests utterances inside Salesforce. TestMu AI adds real voice calls, multi-turn personas and evidence of each action's arguments and results.

items.q: Can TestMu AI test Agentforce voice agents?
items.a: Yes. TestMu AI places real calls to your Agentforce voice agent and grades each one.
A transcript, the topic chosen, each action run with its arguments and results, and a grade.

items.q: Do I need to change my agent?
items.a: No. Tests reach the agent through its existing phone number or chat channel.
